# Elisha Raises the Shunammite Boy (2 Kings 4:35)

## Emotional Focus
Trusting God’s power when a child is sick or hurting.

## Key KJV
“And the child sneezed seven times, and the child opened his eyes.” (2 Kings 4:35)

## Gentle Retelling
A kind woman’s little boy became very sick and died. Elisha prayed, lay on the boy, and God brought him back to life. The mother held her son again with great joy.

## Coloring Prompt
Elisha gently holding a little boy who is waking up happy; mother smiling nearby.

## Read-Along Flow + Response
“God’s power can bring life and healing to those we love.”
